Jordan —

Appreciate the MAP and the clear milestones. A few notes from procurement/legal: 
- Our target for an executed contract is 2027-04-30, but procurement needs the final SOW and commercial terms at least 5 business days prior to signature to process a PO. That means we need the final redline-ready contract in our inbox by 2027-04-23 at the latest.
- Our legal approver (Stephen Wong) must complete a formal review; he typically requires 3 business days for straightforward redlines and up to 7 for more involved changes.
- If there are unusual security addenda (e.g., data residency, custom IP clauses), that will add time — flag them now if you expect any.

Internal approvers: 
- Stephen Wong (Legal)
- Finance: Christine Liu (cc'd on procurement thread as needed)

We can aim for 2027-04-30 signature if Redwood can commit to: final contract delivered by 2027-04-23 and a draft SSO plan for initial onboarding by 2027-04-28.

I'll confirm with procurement today and respond if they require an earlier PO cutoff, but the dates above are the targets.
